name: MediaFetch Pro Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: v1.2.7: Fixed Apple Music single-track download crash; replaced completed queue import button with Retry / Re-download icon; completely removed all UI emojis with clean open-source SVG icons across Pro and Standard editions; optimized stream trimming speed with multi-threaded ffmpeg seek, m3u8 format priority, and guaranteed true 1080p/4K resolution; enlarged and styled IMG PASTE button synced with theme.
Added support for Dribbble video shots, Fiverr gig portfolios, ArtStation demo reels, Apple Music preview audio & artwork, and Behance project media.
Smart universal link extractor: downloads video and audio from any website or creative showcase.
Authentic platform badges and enhanced direct media preview player.
Optimized headless WebView sniffing for challenge-protected creative platforms.
